     2	
     3	How to style a component under `overrides/app/components/` or `overrides/app/theme/`.
     4	Cross-references [overrides.md](./overrides.md) (module-replacement correctness — a
     5	different concern: that file is about not breaking SFCC's own imports, this one is
     6	about what values to reach for once the component compiles). Day-to-day CSS/token
     7	rules live in [css.md](./css.md); this file is the practical "what do I actually type"
     8	companion.
     9	
    10	---
    11	
    12	## The hierarchy — reach for these in order
    13	
    14	1. **`textStyle` prop** for anything textual. `textStyle="body2"`, never a raw `fontSize`.
    15	   All 22 Handover text styles are registered in `theme/foundation/typography.ts`.
    16	2. **Raw `var(--zimm-*)` CSS custom properties** for colour and spacing — `color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)"`,
    17	   `bg="var(--zimm-color-bg-02)"`, `gap="var(--zimm-scale-m)"`. **Never** a bare Chakra/theme
    18	   token string (`color="text.default"`, `gap="m"`) — even though `theme.colors`/`theme.space`
    19	   ARE registered from the same Zimmermann foundations (see `theme/index.ts`'s own comment on
    20	   which scales are and aren't registered) and a bare key resolves to the identical value. This
    21	   is a house-style requirement, not a correctness one: a `var(--zimm-*)` reference is
    22	   unambiguous at every call site, where a bare key forces a PR reviewer to check
    23	   `theme/index.ts`'s registered-scale list to know whether it happens to be correct. Mechanically
    24	   enforced across every recipe file by `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts`'s "no
    25	   override-component style uses a bare token key on a registered scale" test — it walks the
    26	   registered recipe map only, so it cannot see the same mistake made as a JSX/`sx` prop (see
    27	   that test's SCOPE note); apply the same discipline there by hand.
    28	3. **A component's own theme config** — either centralized (`theme/components/<name>.ts`)
    29	   or, per the co-location pattern below, beside the component as `<name>.css.ts` — for
    30	   anything that needs to vary by variant/size/state and isn't already a Chakra prop — see
    31	   "Component-local tokens" and "Co-locating a component's theme file" below. For an
    32	   interactive component with existing Chakra support (buttons, inputs, etc.), this theme
    33	   config is the single source of truth — see "One canonical styling surface per component
    34	   type" below.
    35	4. **`sx` prop** for a one-off Chakra-prop-system gap, per [css.md](./css.md).
    36	5. **Scoped `.scss`** only when `sx` genuinely can't express it (complex pseudo-selectors,
    37	   keyframes) — same file, same rules as [css.md](./css.md) already documents.
    38	
    39	**Never**: a raw hex/px/rem/em literal in a component file — reach for the token
    40	instead. The one standing exception is `zimmButton.css.ts`'s provisional height/padding
    41	constants (`BTN_HEIGHT_LG`/`BTN_HEIGHT_SM`/`BTN_PADDING_Y`), pending UI-designer
    42	sign-off — see Units below. Run `npm run audit:tokens` (`node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`)
    43	before opening a PR that touches `overrides/app/components/**` or
    44	`overrides/app/theme/components/**` — it greps for exactly this, scoped to those two paths
    45	(`.ts`/`.tsx`/`.scss`, excluding `*.test.ts(x)` and `*.stories.tsx`). A match is downgraded
    46	from a failure to an acknowledged exception when the surrounding comment block already
    47	contains `provisional`, `pending`, `placeholder`, or an explicit `audit-allow: <reason>` —
    48	the exact vocabulary this codebase already uses for its documented raw-value exceptions, so
    49	existing well-commented code doesn't need a second, separately-maintained allow-list. Built
    50	2026-08-23 — it is not wired into CI yet, deliberately: someone still needs to own triaging a
    51	full run's worth of pre-existing findings first (a first run against this repo surfaced 14
    52	genuine pre-existing violations, none touched by that session, all outside its scope to fix).
    53	Note this is a *different, broader* check than `recipeGuards.test.ts`'s bare-token-key guard
    54	mentioned above: that one exists and runs today (`npm run test`), but only catches a bare
    55	Chakra key standing in for a zimm var — it says nothing about a raw hex/px/rem/em literal,
    56	which is what `audit:tokens` is for.
    57	
    58	## Units
    59	
    60	- **`rem`** for anything that should scale with the user's root font-size / browser zoom

=== HEAD css.md full ===
     1	# CSS & Styling Conventions
     2	
     3	Chakra UI and `.scss` conventions. See [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) > Rules > Styling for the
     4	higher-level policy (Chakra props first, `.scss` only when insufficient, theme file
     5	ownership/tiers) — this file covers the concrete day-to-day rules underneath that policy.
     6	
     7	---
     8	
     9	## Tokens — no hardcoded design values
    10	
    11	Chakra UI props must use the Chakra token system — no hardcoded hex colours, no pixel
    12	values for spacing, no raw font sizes. Tokens belong in
    13	[overrides/app/theme/foundation/](../../overrides/app/theme/) (Tier 1 — see
    14	[frozenFiles.md](./frozenFiles.md)).
    15	
    16	```tsx
    17	// ❌ hardcoded
    18	<Box color="#1A1A1A" padding="16px" />
    19	
    20	// ❌ a bare Chakra/theme token string — resolves correctly (theme.colors/theme.space ARE
    21	// registered from the Zimmermann foundations) but is still not allowed in an override
    22	// component; see overrideStyling.md's hierarchy point 2 for why
    23	<Box color="text.default" padding="m" />
    24	
    25	// ✅ token, as a raw var(--zimm-*) reference
    26	<Box color="var(--zimm-color-text-default)" padding="var(--zimm-scale-m)" />
    27	```
    28	
    29	Type is its own case, not shown above — set it with `textStyle` (`textStyle="body2"`), never
    30	a raw `fontSize`, per [overrideStyling.md](./overrideStyling.md) point 1. There's no
    31	`var(--zimm-*)` substitute for the composite `textStyle` expansion itself, only for its
    32	individual pieces (`var(--zimm-font-size-*)` etc.), so `textStyle` stays a bare key —
    33	it's the one entry in the hierarchy that isn't a colour/spacing token.
    34	
    35	**The raw-hex/px/rem/em half of this has a script but no CI gate yet.**
    36	`npm run audit:tokens` (`scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`) scans `overrides/app/components/**`
    37	and `overrides/app/theme/components/**` for exactly this — see
    38	[overrideStyling.md](./overrideStyling.md)'s `Never` note for the full scope and its
    39	acknowledged-exception rules. It's not wired into CI (no `.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/` rule
    40	either), so nothing blocks a merge that skips running it — that's still a real gap, just not
    41	an unstarted one.
    42	The bare-token-vs-`var(--zimm-*)` half above **is** mechanically enforced for recipe files —
    43	see `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts`, which runs on every `npm run test` — though it
    44	can't see the same mistake made as a JSX/`sx` prop; that half still relies on review.
    45	
    46	---
    47	
    48	## `.scss` — only when Chakra props are insufficient
    49	
    50	Per AGENTS.md, reach for a `.scss` file alongside a component only when Chakra's prop system
    51	genuinely can't express what's needed (e.g. complex pseudo-selectors, keyframe animations,
    52	print styles). When you do:
    53	
    54	- **File naming:** matches the component file exactly — `productTile.scss` next to
    55	  `productTile/index.tsx` (see [conventions.md](./conventions.md) > File naming and folder
    56	  structure for the folder layout this sits in).
    57	- **Scoped, co-located only.** No global stylesheets outside `overrides/app/theme/` — a
    58	  component's `.scss` file must only affect that component's own markup.
    59	- **Nesting depth ≤ 3 levels.** Beyond that, the selector is almost always reaching into a
    60	  child component's internals rather than styling its own root — a sign the styling belongs
    61	  in that child instead, or that Chakra's `sx` prop / a theme variant would express it more
    62	  directly.
    63	- **No ID selectors.** Class-based only — an ID selector's specificity makes it
    64	  disproportionately hard to override later (including by a legitimate future Chakra
    65	  variant), and IDs aren't guaranteed unique when a component renders more than once on a
    66	  page.
    67	- **No `!important`** without an inline comment explaining why the override is genuinely
    68	  unavoidable (e.g. fighting a third-party widget's inline styles) — same reasoning as the
    69	  `any`/non-null-assertion escape hatches in [typescript.md](./typescript.md): allowed, but
    70	  the reason has to be visible at the point of use, not left for the next reader to guess.
    71	- **Prefer Chakra's `sx` prop or a theme variant extension over a new `.scss` file** for
    72	  anything that's really just "a Chakra style the prop system doesn't have a named prop for"
    73	  — a new global class is a bigger footprint than a one-off `sx` override, and `sx` keeps the
    74	  style co-located with the JSX that uses it instead of a separate file to keep in sync.
